segments.name: Power & Control
products: specialized AC/DC electric motors and generators
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets systems and components that provide or control aircraft power, selling to engine and power suppliers, airlines, maintenance suppliers and military agencies.
segments.evidence: The Power & Control segment includes operations that primarily develop, produce and market systems and components that predominately provide power to or control power of the aircraft utilizing electronic, fluid, power and mechanical motion control technologies.

segments.name: Airframe
products: engineered connectors and elastomer sealing solutions
engineered audio, radio and antenna systems
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets systems and components for non-power airframe applications, selling to airframe manufacturers, cabin system suppliers, airlines, maintenance suppliers and military agencies.
segments.evidence: The Airframe segment includes operations that primarily develop, produce and market systems and components that are used in non-power airframe applications utilizing airframe and cabin structure technologies.

segments.name: Non-aviation
products: seat belts and safety restraints for ground transportation applications
mechanical/electromechanical actuators and controls for space applications
hydraulic/electromechanical actuators and fuel valves for land-based gas turbine
refueling systems for heavy equipment used in mining, construction and other ind
turbine controls for the energy and oil and gas markets
segments.description: Develops, produces and markets products for non-aviation markets, selling to off-road vehicle suppliers, child restraint system suppliers, satellite and space suppliers, equipment manufacturers and utilities.
segments.evidence: The Non-aviation segment includes operations that primarily develop, produce and market products for non-aviation markets.

revenueModel.text: Aircraft operators, OEMs, airlines, distributors, governments and defense and industrial customers pay for proprietary engineered components and aftermarket parts and services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our customers include: (1) distributors of aerospace components; (2) worldwide commercial airlines, including national and regional airlines; (3) large commercial transport and regional and business aircraft OEMs; (4) various armed forces of the United States and friendly foreign governments; (5) defense OEMs; (6) system suppliers; and (7) various other industrial customers.
